statement: Commercial oil tanker transits through the Strait of Hormuz fall to a publicly reported near-total halt for at least 72 continuous hours at any point between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-16, following the renewed mine strikes on the Sidr and Senegal Prosperity tankers.
resolution: TRUE if EIA, Kpler, Lloyds List, or two independent wire services report a continuous 72-hour or longer halt in Hormuz tanker transits within the window; FALSE if transits continue throughout without such a gap.
failure_condition: No wire service or shipping-data provider reports a continuous 72-hour or longer halt in Hormuz commercial transits during the window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
